title: How to Fix Project P.I.T.T. Crashes, Low FPS, Saves & Missing Tools
description:
Answer-first troubleshooting for the launch-window cluster of Project P.I.T.T. problems. Try this first: ensure you are running the current full-release guidance (recent full-release versions fixed multiple issues in this cluster), consult the Fuse page if you have missing key items, and use the Pause Menu → Clear Items fallback to remove many placed items quickly (Clear Items removes items and does not refund money).

Crashes:
Players report crashes as part of the launch-window problem cluster. Recent full-release versions have fixed multiple issues in this area, but some reports remain unresolved. If you experience crashes, note whether they are repeatable and report them with current-version details; distinguish between known, fixed behavior and outstanding reports when seeking help.

Low FPS and Mouse Control (including high-polling-rate mice):
Low FPS and mouse unable-to-turn or control issues are included in current player reports. High-polling-rate mice have been associated with some control problems in reports; recent versions address many problems but not every report is resolved. Treat high-polling-rate behavior as a possible contributor and report persistent control or performance problems under the current version.

Save Reliability and Continue-After-Ending Saves:
Players have reported broken or unreliable saves and continue-after-ending save behavior. Recent full-release guidance covers many fixes, but reports remain in some cases. If you encounter unreliable saves, preserve any available evidence and report the issue; use the game’s documented recovery and cleanup options where appropriate.

Missing, Stuck or Lava-Fallen Tools:
Reports include lost unique tools, stuck or inaccessible tools, and tools falling into lava. For missing key-item recovery, consult the Fuse page for current guidance rather than seeking a separate missing-Fuse page. For tools that are stuck or inaccessible, document the circumstances and report them under current-version guidance.

Clear Items and Bulk Removal:
The Pause Menu → Clear Items option is the documented 1.0.5 cleanup fallback; it removes placed items in bulk and does not refund money. Use that as the in-game cleanup fallback if you need to clear many placed items or panels quickly and accept the lack of refunds.

Neighboring pages and related systems:
Trade Terminal, Panel Rack, and Automation are the relevant neighboring pages for cleanup, panel, and automation failures. Check those pages for additional, related troubleshooting or recovery steps.

FAQ:
Q: Should I make a separate missing-Fuse report page? A: No — the Fuse page already contains the current missing-key-item recovery guidance; link or refer to that page. Q: Does Clear Items refund money? A: No — Clear Items removes items and does not refund money. Q: Are all reports confirmed universal bugs? A: No — distinguish current-version guidance, player reports, and unresolved cases when investigating. Q: What should I do first? A: Run current-version guidance, consult the Fuse page for missing-key-item recovery, and use Pause Menu → Clear Items as the in-game cleanup fallback when needed.

Related links:
See the Fuse page for missing-key-item recovery guidance, and check Trade Terminal, Panel Rack, and Automation pages for cleanup and automation-related issues.
